company.name: MySyara
company.shortDescription: MySyara is a platform that delivers car servicing solutions to the customer and provides supply chain solutions to the workshop.
company.description: MySyara online automotive service provider that delivers all types of car servicing solutions to doorsteps. The company provides a state-of-the-art garage-on-wheels which arrives with all the tools needed to get on the move. Changing or charging car batteries, changing or repairing tires, and even running a complete diagnosis of the car at any location are few among the many services offered by the company. Additionally, it also offers a car spa using a waterless eco-friendly car wash, massively reducing the water wastage involved in the process.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $180,000, or 9.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,877,193 to $14,721,395, a 2.5x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 51 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
